text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
All right, kicking off this year's event!
Spring Fan Appreciation Festival!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Marathon in dead heat!
Which Uma Musume will cross gate first!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, next is 『Fight-Oh』 rhythm! Give it
everything to cheer! One-two!!

text_block_list.name: Festival Fans
text_block_list.text: Fight-Oh--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Following first place Uma Musume,
pack approaches goal! Final Uma Musume
reaches gate and crosses line!!

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Ehehe. King, thanks for cheering. Made
it to end because of you. Heard your voice whole
time running...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Not just my cheering. Fans who wished for you to make it
across finish line helped too.

text_block_list.name: Festival Fans
text_block_list.text:
Good work-! Good job out there-!
Total inspiration~!!

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Eh? Ehehe... you're right.
So many people cheering for me...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Precisely, take it all in. All right... Cheer
Squad, fall in!! Moving to next event!!

text_block_list.name: Nature&Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hooray! Hooray!!
Tr-a-ce-n!!

text_block_list.name: Spectating Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, going all out this year too~. Other
runners look like having blast too...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Join in too~~♪ Feel your urge to cheer!
Just shout however feels good!

text_block_list.name: Spectating Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Uh, eeeh... b-but,
don't know call...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No problem! Will teach call,
just copy us. Let's
have fun♪ One, two!

text_block_list.name: Pearl&Fan
text_block_list.text: Oooh, Tracen! Tracen Fight-Oh--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectating Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, cheers super intense~!
Maybe I'll join too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...! By all means! Have lyric cards if needed, so
enjoy to fullest!

text_block_list.name: Fan Holding a Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Cheering crew going super hard
at this year's Festival~

text_block_list.name: Fan Holding A Fan C
text_block_list.text: Totally! Ended up joining in too~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(...Visitors' eyes shining bright. Incredible... so this is
power of King-san's cheering...!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...King-san, I will-

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
-definitely finish!
No matter what obstacles await... just like you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Will run to make fans thrilled!!

text_block_list.name: Fan Festival Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Announcement for 『Scavenger Hunt, 4000m Obstacle
Course』 participants!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Now that morning events wrapped, schedule
suddenly packed. Bicycle race at front gate,
Quiz show in gym at same time...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Must split up. Leave bicycle race
cheering to Nature-san and Pearl-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Got it-. So King cheers at gym. After that
is 『Scavenger Hunt, 4000m Obstacle Course』, so
regroup at course then?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
King-! Checked around, someone in
Cheer Squad dropped this!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
! S-sorry about that!!
Been rushing around non-stop...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Take deep breath at times like this!
Got told that constantly last year when needing to calm down!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Nature, time to move, starting soon.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my bad.
Heading out then!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, do your best! All right everyone, move out! Get
to positions and keep working hard with
fans to cheer everybody on!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Members
text_block_list.text: Osu!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, thanks for advice!
Please keep watching our cheering!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Roger that!
Heh, turned out pretty reliable, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Committee Chair!!
Found this left behind during patrol...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh. This is--

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Must be seriously short-handed, huh?
Care for small detour? ...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hooray, hooray!
Fight-Oh, Tracen! Wooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Nyaa~! Total em-bar-rass-ment, but... since captain asked,
gotta keep cheering!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Everyone- stay hydrated and grab snack!
So we make it through to end without--

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
『Announcement from Fan Appreciation Festival
Executive Committee. Regarding 『Scavenger Hunt, 4000m
Obstacle Course』 scheduled for 1:00 PM--』
